parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for flagging this. I’m sorry for the billing confusion. 

I can see you reported two charges for the annual plan renewal dated May 1, tied to invoices INV-9031 and INV-9032, and you’d like one reversed and to confirm which invoice should remain for your accounting.

To make sure we reverse the correct transaction, could you please reply with:
1) The amount charged on INV-9031 and the amount charged on INV-9032
2) The transaction IDs (or the payment reference/authorization codes) for each invoice, if available
3) Which invoice you prefer to keep (INV-9031 or INV-9032), or if you want us to decide based on our billing records

Once we have that, we’ll escalate this to our billing team for review and action on the duplicate charge(s).
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to the billing team for review and action on the duplicate charge(s) once the requested details are provided
safety_notes: User requested reversal and confirmation; exact reversal/refund status and which invoice to keep require internal billing record verification and transaction identifiers.
Avoid confirming resolution or reversals until billing team reviews INV-9031/INV-9032 and associated transaction/payment references.

The amounts charged for INV-9031 and INV-9032.

Which of the two invoices the customer prefers to keep (or whether they want guidance based on internal billing records).
